answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond and then keep a lantern lit: a verifiable delay function beacon it must re-light each epoch, proving continuous computation rather than a copied identity. New accounts enter a ferrous hardening window with no earnings until several beacons pass, while a sable ledger records each beacon timing, so a sybil farm spinning up thousands of clones must pay the bond and burn compute for every one, making the attack cost scale linearly with size instead of staying nearly free.
